in_marathi.name: Shreyansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Fortune, Prosperous One
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shreyansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who possesses the lord of prosperity and wealth. The name Shreyansh is derived from the Sanskrit word shri, which means 'wealth' and ansh, meaning 'lord'.
